title: Desenvolvedor Backend Jr
gaps: Regime de contratação não informado no anúncio.

requirements.heading: Accountabilities
requirements.text:
• Participate in project planning and contribute to the design, development, and optimization of new software features.

  • Apply programming logic and backend development principles to build and maintain reliable software solutions.

  • Develop backend functionalities using C# and related technologies within the .NET ecosystem.

  • Analyze requirements with internal clients and stakeholders to understand business needs and define appropriate technical solutions.

  • Collect, organize, analyze, and monitor information required to support software development and business processes.

  • Understand user and client needs and recommend relevant technical approaches, data views, and analyses.

  • Develop and maintain APIs and backend services, including WebAPI-based solutions.

  • Work with SQL databases to support data access, organization, and processing.

  • Use Git and version control practices to manage code changes and collaborate with other developers.

  • Contribute to software quality by following development standards, identifying issues, and supporting debugging and optimization activities.

  • Collaborate with team members to improve existing functionality and deliver solutions aligned with business requirements.

    • Requirements:

    • Approximately 6 months to 1 year of experience in backend development or related technical activities.

    • Foundational experience with backend technologies, .NET, C#, SQL, programming logic, Angular, WebAPI, and Git.

    • Understanding of software development principles and the ability to contribute to application development and maintenance.

    • Familiarity with databases, APIs, version control, and software quality practices.

    • Ability to analyze requirements, understand business needs, and translate them into practical technical solutions.

    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.

    • Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work with internal stakeholders and development teams.

    • A completed bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Economics, or a related field.

    • Fluency in English or Spanish is considered an advantage.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote work arrangement within Brazil.

      • Full-time employment opportunity.

      • Health, dental, and life insurance plans.

      • Meal allowance for use at supermarkets and restaurants.

      • Home office allowance to help cover remote work expenses, including internet costs.

      • Access to a gym membership subscription app.

      • Educational partnerships offering discounts at universities, English schools, and other learning providers.

      • Four collective days off per year, with a shared break once per quarter.

      • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) providing psychological, legal, and financial support.

      • Payroll-deducted loan option.

      • Discounts with partner brands, including Dell and Microsoft.

      • Ongoing learning, training, mentorship, and professional development opportunities.

      • An inclusive, collaborative workplace that encourages new ideas, personal growth, and teamwork.
